svg.title: Penzragon's contribution city
svg.desc: 1950 contributions from 2025-10-26 to 2026-10-31. 53 buildings represent consecutive weeks, oldest on the left. Height uses a relative square-root scale for weekly contribution volume; window patterns reflect active weekdays. Cars and a white wolf move along the waterfront. Refreshed daily; no private repository names are included.
svg.text: A year, built one week at a time
1 building = 1 week · Height = contribution volume · Window glow = active days
Oldest weeks on the left → newest on the right · Refreshed daily
